_readme: Story quests for the quest system, built by ArtDirection/Story/tools/build_quests.py from main-quest.md and side-quests.md. Every line is {id, speaker, text}; its voice cue is /Game/Audio/Jam/Voice/Cues/SCue_VO_<id>. Fields beyond the README format (cutscene*, lines*On*, ifInfected, startsTarnished, scriptedHold, afterLine, giveItems, rewardOnComplete, failIfDies, ordered, optional, requireInfected/cure) are story intent: support what's cheap, ignore the rest, and the quest still works. Person ids are people.json ids (actor tag Person_<id>); markers use the Story Marker names in people.json -> markers.story_names.

_cutsceneTriggers.Intro: new game (game flow's PlayNewGameIntro; the quest only waits, 4 s timeout)
_cutsceneTriggers.GiltTower: the Gilt Tower sealed door's OnOpened
_cutsceneTriggers.MirrorWhole: BookComplete (played by the cutscene/game side, not the quest)
_cutsceneTriggers.Ending: villain-finale calls it after the dissolve

items.name: A small barrel of real lamp oil
A bolt of wool with a gold selvedge

quests.title: The Mirror Made Whole
quests.summary: Bring the three mirror pages together, make the mirror whole, and burn the Tarnish out of Lanthorne.

steps.title: Lantern Law
steps.description: Dusk bell. The Lamp Companies are marching again, and Ilse wants me on Lantern Row.

objectives.text: Watch

steps.title: Lantern Row
steps.description: Ilse made me cast at a lamp post like I was twelve again. She's frightened. She doesn't get frightened.

objectives.text: Find Ilse Varrow on Lantern Row

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: You're late, and you're limping. Which first?

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Neither. I came the long way.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Mm. Show me your hands. Aim at the lamp post.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Light's the only thing it hates. Cast like you mean it.

steps.speaker: ilse_varrow

steps.title: Lantern Row
steps.description: Light's the only thing it hates.

objectives.text: Cast a spell

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Better. Now keep that hand ready. It's close tonight.

steps.speaker: ilse_varrow

steps.title: The First Face
steps.description: It took Jory in the middle of Bell Square. Light brought him back. I didn't know it could.

objectives.text: Find the burning eyes

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Somebody's wearing the Tarnish. Find them.

steps.speaker: wren_hale

steps.title: The First Face
steps.description: Light burns it out, if you're quick.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Jory
objectives.fallbackText: Burn the Tarnish out of them

lines.speaker: the_tarnish
lines.text: Your friend hums when he's frightened. We like the tune.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Hold on, Jory. This is going to sting.

linesOnComplete.speaker: wren_hale
linesOnComplete.text: You're out. Breathe. It's gone from you.

linesOnComplete.speaker: ilse_varrow
linesOnComplete.text: So light does burn it out. Good. Now you know.

linesOnFail.speaker: wren_hale
linesOnFail.text: No. No, I was quick. I was quick.

steps.title: Through the Glass
steps.description: One page in each side. The first is in Pewterside. I'm going down through the glass.

objectives.text: Find a Pewterside shard
hints: Drifters bring them through. Ask under the Lantern Gate.

objectives.text: Step down into Pewterside

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: It wants the pages. So we want them first.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: One's on the Weigh-House roof, down in Pewterside.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Then I need a Pewterside shard.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Drifters bring them through. Ask under the Lantern Gate.

steps.speaker: ilse_varrow

kit_marrow.speaker: kit_marrow
kit_marrow.text: Grey ones wash up here sometimes. Found one by the pillar. Yours.

jory_pell.speaker: jory_pell
jory_pell.text: Ren? It was in my mouth. It was singing.

steps.title: Dull as Ever
steps.description: Pewterside's grey as a spoon and twice as stubborn. The first page was on the Weigh-House roof, under eleven years of pigeons.

objectives.text: Find the Old Weigh-House
Climb to the Weigh-House roof

ivy_harker.speaker: ivy_harker
ivy_harker.text: For the record, the roof's been glowing. Is that yours? Lawfully?

ivy_harker.speaker: wren_hale
ivy_harker.text: It will be. Which way up?

winnie_cobb.speaker: winnie_cobb
winnie_cobb.text: Round the back, love, the stair by the drainpipe. Mind the third step.

horace_pratt.speaker: horace_pratt
horace_pratt.text: Nobody's been up there in eleven years. Mark my words, it'll be the death of you.

steps.title: Hold the Line
steps.description: We held the Lantern Gate. Three people walked away with their own eyes. Maud didn't say thank you, which means she meant it.

objectives.text: Step back up into Giltside
Hold the Lantern Gate: burn the Tarnish out of 3 people

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: Silverer. You picked a busy night to come home. Hold here with us.

steps.speaker: maud_kettering

1.speaker: nell_bramley
1.text: It came out of them! Sergeant, it came right out!

2.speaker: hollis_greave
2.text: Course you can do that. Course you can. Keep going.

0.75.speaker: maud_kettering
0.75.text: We're losing faces faster than we save them. Faster, Silverer!

squadLines.speaker: sela_brask
squadLines.text: Third Company, by the gate. Silverer, keep your light off my line.

FirstPage.speaker: the_tarnish
FirstPage.text: You moved a page, Silverer. We felt it in every face.

FirstPage.speaker: wren_hale
FirstPage.text: Good. Feel the next one too.

steps.title: The Key Where Light Won't Go Out
steps.description: Maud hid the tower key under a lamp that never goes out. She's been guarding it from her own captain's face.

objectives.text: Find the Gilt Tower key

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: You want the Gilt Tower. I sealed it. I hid the key.

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: A tarnished came for it wearing my captain's face. I trust nobody's face now.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Then trust what I just did.

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: Noted. It's where the light never goes out. Go and look.

steps.speaker: maud_kettering

linesOnComplete.speaker: wren_hale
linesOnComplete.text: Brass and warm. Maud, you sentimental thing.

steps.title: The Gilt Tower
steps.description: The second page was in the Gilt Tower, where it's always been. The Tarnish says I'm building it a door.

objectives.text: Open the Gilt Tower
Take the page inside the tower

1.speaker: wren_hale
1.text: Second leaf. It's warm, like it's been waiting.

steps.title: The Cracked Crown
steps.description: Third leaf, in the cracked tower. The mirror is whole. Now it burns.

objectives.text: Step up into Frostside from inside the tower
Take the last page

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: The last leaf is above you, boy. Same tower, colder light.

lines.speaker: ilse_varrow
lines.text: Your mother went that way. Come back from it.

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: That's the plan. It's always been the plan.

steps.speaker: ilse_varrow

0.speaker: wren_hale
0.text: Cracks everywhere. It's been clawing at these walls.

0.speaker: the_tarnish
0.text: She stood just there, your mother. Right where you are.

steps.title: Let the Light Through
steps.description: It's gone. I looked into the whole mirror, and the only face in it was mine.

objectives.text: Climb to the top of the Frost Tower
Burn out the Tarnish with the Final Spell

quests.title: The Cellar at the Lamplight
quests.summary: Goldie has kept her tarnished husband chained in the inn's cellar for nine days.

offer.speaker: goldie_fairweather
offer.text: Sweetling. Is it true you can bring them back? Truly?

offer.speaker: goldie_fairweather
offer.text: Hal's in the cellar. Nine days. Don't you dare tell Maud.

offer.speaker: wren_hale
offer.text: I won't. Give me the key.

steps.title: Down the Stairs
steps.description: Hal's been in the cellar nine days. Goldie feeds him through a hatch.

objectives.text: Go down to the Lamplight's cellar

lines.speaker: hal_fairweather
lines.text: Marigold... we are so cold down here.

steps.speaker: hal_fairweather

steps.title: Hal
steps.description: The chain gave.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Hal

lines.speaker: hal_fairweather
lines.text: Open the hatch. We only want to see you.

steps.speaker: hal_fairweather

linesOnComplete.speaker: wren_hale
linesOnComplete.text: Hal. Hal, look at me. Your own eyes.

linesOnComplete.speaker: hal_fairweather
linesOnComplete.text: Nine days in the dark, and you brought me up.

turnInLines.speaker: goldie_fairweather
turnInLines.text: I fed him through a hatch like a dog. Nine days. Nine.

turnInLines.speaker: goldie_fairweather
turnInLines.text: Take this. Hal kept it from the bridge. It's grey glass.

fail.speaker: goldie_fairweather
fail.text: Don't. Don't say anything. Just go upstairs, Wren.

afterLine.speaker: goldie_fairweather
afterLine.text: Hal's complaining about the ale again. Isn't it wonderful?

quests.title: After the Humming
quests.summary: Jory can't play. His fiddle is lying in Bell Square, and two tarnished stand over it.

offer.speaker: jory_pell
offer.text: I keep reaching for my fiddle, Ren. I left it in the square.

offer.speaker: jory_pell
offer.text: Every tune I think of, there's something humming under it.

steps.title: Bell Square
steps.description: Someone's standing over it. Two someones.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of the people by the fiddle
Pick up Jory's fiddle

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Someone's standing over it. Two someones.

steps.speaker: wren_hale

linesOnComplete.speaker: wren_hale
linesOnComplete.text: Bridge is cracked. Strings are fine. He'll live.

steps.title: Bring It Home
steps.description: Bridge is cracked. Strings are fine.

objectives.text: Bring the fiddle to Jory

turnInLines.speaker: jory_pell
turnInLines.text: You found it. Oh, you beauty. Hold still, let me try.

turnInLines.speaker: jory_pell
turnInLines.text: It's still humming. But I'm louder. I'm louder than it.

quests.title: Letters Through the Glass
quests.summary: Nell, a guard who hides that she's a drifter, writes to the mother she lost through a rift.

offer.speaker: nell_bramley
offer.text: Sorry, I mean, this is nothing. It's a letter. To Pewterside.

offer.speaker: nell_bramley
offer.text: Coal Lane. Edie Bramley. She'd be old now. If she's... if.

offer.speaker: wren_hale
offer.text: I'll find her. What do I tell her?

steps.title: Coal Lane
steps.description: Edie Bramley. She'd be old now.

objectives.text: Step down into Pewterside
Give Edie Bramley the letter at the Coal Lane tram stop

linesOnComplete.speaker: edie_bramley
linesOnComplete.text: That's her hand. That's her writing. Nine years old, she was.

linesOnComplete.speaker: edie_bramley
linesOnComplete.text: Give her this. The stub from that day. And this glass came through when she went. Take it.

linesIfTargetWasCured.speaker: edie_bramley
linesIfTargetWasCured.text: My head's full of other people's voices. You've got a letter? For me?

steps.title: Two Tickets
steps.description: She kept the ticket. Fourteen years.

objectives.text: Bring the ticket to Nell

turnInLines.speaker: nell_bramley
turnInLines.text: She kept the ticket. Fourteen years. Steady, Nell. Steady.

afterLine.speaker: nell_bramley
afterLine.text: Next stop, Coal Lane. Mum used to say that. Funny.

afterLine.speaker: edie_bramley
afterLine.text: Two tickets, please. One's for my girl. She's on the gold side.

quests.title: The Queen of Coal Lane
quests.summary: Hester won't go indoors until her subjects are home, and the tarnished are coming down Coal Lane.

offer.speaker: hester_quaile
offer.text: My subjects are out after dark, young man. I won't go in till they're home.

offer.speaker: hester_quaile
offer.text: Something's coming down the lane. I can hear its feet. Wrong feet.

offer.speaker: wren_hale
offer.text: Stay on the step, Your Majesty. I've got the lane.

steps.title: Wrong Feet
steps.description: Something's coming down the lane.

objectives.text: Defend Coal Lane: keep the tarnished off Hester's doorstep

lines.speaker: sid_kettle
lines.text: Right. Nan stays behind me. Right.

steps.speaker: sid_kettle

30.speaker: walter_dunmore
30.text: That's check, you blasted things! Check!

hester_quaile.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Hester

linesOnCure.speaker: hester_quaile
linesOnCure.text: Was I... no. Don't tell me. The Queen was never gone.

linesOnComplete.speaker: hester_quaile
linesOnComplete.text: My subjects are home. Every one. You may go.

steps.title: Fifty-One Years
steps.description: Walter has carried a ring for fifty-one years.

objectives.text: Talk to Walter

lines.speaker: walter_dunmore
lines.text: Hester. Fifty-one years I've carried this. Will you blasted well have it?

lines.speaker: hester_quaile
lines.text: Walter Dunmore. I can't see the ring. I can hear you shaking. Yes.

afterLine.speaker: hester_quaile
afterLine.text: Our royal Silverer. Walter, curtsey. Oh, don't, your knee.

quests.title: The Glazier's Eyeglass
quests.summary: Professor Quell needs the Glazier's lens. An old woman in Pewterside has it, and wants only to be listened to.

offer.speaker: tobias_quell
offer.text: The Glazier ground a lens to read silvered script. Which is to say, the pages.

offer.speaker: tobias_quell
offer.text: A family in Pewterside kept it. Pollard. Find it, and I'll read what the pages say.

steps.title: The Fish Steps
steps.description: A family in Pewterside kept it. Pollard.

objectives.text: Find Ada Pollard on the Fish Steps in Pewterside

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: The eyeglass? Oh, dearie. Sit down. It's a long story, isn't it, Arthur?

steps.speaker: ada_pollard

steps.title: The Whole Story
steps.description: Nobody ever hears the end of one of Ada's stories.

objectives.text: Listen to Ada's story

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: My granny's granny swept the Glazier's floor. Every morning, glass dust.

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: The night of the cut, the Glazier put this in her apron and said, keep it from the dark.

lines.speaker: ada_pollard
lines.text: Nine of us have kept it. In a sugar tin, mostly. Arthur thought it was a button.

steps.speaker: ada_pollard

linesOnComplete.speaker: ada_pollard
linesOnComplete.text: You listened to the end. Nobody does. Here. Take it, dearie.

steps.title: Into, Not At
steps.description: The last page asks the Silverer to look into the whole mirror.

objectives.text: Bring the eyeglass to Professor Quell

turnInLines.speaker: tobias_quell
turnInLines.text: Remarkable. With this, the script reads plain. Each page has a line, and the last one...

turnInLines.speaker: tobias_quell
turnInLines.text: ...says a Silverer must look into the whole mirror. Into it, not at it. I don't know what that costs.

turnInLines.speaker: wren_hale
turnInLines.text: Nine years of not looking. Seems about due.

afterLine.speaker: ada_pollard
afterLine.text: There's my good listener. Arthur, it's the Silverer. Sit, sit.

quests.title: Something Whole
quests.summary: At the dusk bell the Third Company will push the drifters back into the canal rift. Something is coming through it tonight.

offer.speaker: kit_marrow
offer.text: Dusk bell, they send us back. Fen says she'll go in the canal first.

offer.speaker: fen_lowry
offer.text: Says who? I'm not going back. It's warm here. Warm.

steps.title: The Rift Post
steps.description: Rift's humming loud tonight.

objectives.text: Talk to Ros at the canal rift post

lines.speaker: ros_thrale
lines.text: Orders are orders, glass-boy. I've been losing count of who goes past me.

lines.speaker: ros_thrale
lines.text: Rift's humming loud tonight. Something's coming through with the drifters.

steps.speaker: ros_thrale

steps.title: Under the Gate
steps.description: Nobody's going in the canal.

objectives.text: Defend the drifters' camp

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Nobody's going in the canal. Hold here with me.

steps.speaker: wren_hale

45.speaker: fen_lowry
45.text: It knows my name. It says it's warm where it is.

fen_lowry.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Fen

linesOnCure.speaker: fen_lowry
linesOnCure.text: It lied. It wasn't warm. It was nothing.

steps.title: New Orders
steps.description: They held the gate with us.

objectives.text: Talk to Captain Brask

lines.speaker: sela_brask
lines.text: They held the gate with us. They stay. That's the new order.

steps.speaker: sela_brask

turnInLines.speaker: kit_marrow
turnInLines.text: Here. It's whole, look. Not a crack in it. Frostside glass.

fail.speaker: kit_marrow
fail.text: We came all this way. All this way for the cold to find us.

quests.failNote: Kit or Fen dying does not fail the quest; the survivor says SQ6_F1 and the reward is still given.

afterLine.speaker: sela_brask
afterLine.text: Drifters on the gate roster. Never thought I'd write that.

quests.title: The Lamps on Bell Lane
quests.summary: Corin promised his dying father Bell Lane would never go dark. He's been watering the oil.

offer.speaker: corin_ashby
offer.text: Three lamps on Bell Lane won't take. I've trimmed them. I've prayed over them.

offer.speaker: corin_ashby
offer.text: You carry fire in your hands, Silverer. Would you lend it to them?

steps.title: Three Lamps
steps.description: Three lamps on Bell Lane won't take.

objectives.text: Relight the failing lamps on Bell Lane
Relight the failing lamps on Bell Lane
Relight the failing lamps on Bell Lane

steps.title: Watered Oil
steps.description: He's been watering the oil.

objectives.text: Talk to Corin

lines.speaker: corin_ashby
lines.text: They'll fail again. I've been watering the oil. Father would weep.

steps.speaker: corin_ashby

steps.title: Real Oil
steps.description: Dov has oil. Corin never asked.

objectives.text: Ask Dov for lamp oil
Bring the oil to Corin

0.speaker: dov_merriman
0.text: Oil for Corin? By the furnace, why didn't the fool ask? Take the barrel.

turnInLines.speaker: corin_ashby
turnInLines.text: Real oil. Bell Lane will hold till dawn. Light holds. It holds.

afterLine.speaker: corin_ashby
afterLine.text: Not one flicker all night, Silverer. Not one.

quests.title: Sorrel's Shed
quests.summary: A Frostside healer keeps three tarnished tied in her shed. One is a Giltside dancer who fell through a rift.

offer.speaker: sorrel_vey
offer.text: You burn it out with light. I've seen you. My shed. Now.

steps.title: The Shed
steps.description: Three of them. Tied, fed, alive.

objectives.text: Go to Sorrel's shed

lines.speaker: sorrel_vey
lines.text: Three of them. Tied, fed, alive. Don't look at me like that.

steps.speaker: sorrel_vey

steps.title: Patients
steps.description: Light is the only thing that's ever worked.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Sorrel's patients

steps.title: Gold in Your Coat
steps.description: Petra kept dancing, in her head, the whole time.

objectives.text: Talk to Petra

lines.speaker: petra_lisle
lines.text: Gold. Your coat's got gold in it. Am I home? Am I near home?

lines.speaker: petra_lisle
lines.text: Lucan. Tell Lucan I kept dancing. In my head. The whole time.

steps.speaker: petra_lisle

steps.title: She's Alive
steps.description: Lucan needs to hear it.

objectives.text: Tell Lucan that Petra is alive

lines.speaker: lucan_marlowe
lines.text: Alive? She's... Lucan can't... I can't breathe. Say it again.

lines.speaker: lucan_marlowe
lines.text: Then I'll learn to walk through glass if it kills me.

steps.speaker: lucan_marlowe

afterLine.speaker: lucan_marlowe
afterLine.text: She's alive. Five, six, seven, eight. She's alive.

quests.availability: Only when the hero is in Frostside's streets (not inside the sealed Frost Tower). Skip if the map has no Frostside streets.

quests.title: Unsigned
quests.summary: For fifty years someone has left wool on Barnaby's doorstep, unsigned.

offer.speaker: barnaby_thrale
offer.text: Wool on the doorstep again, Silverer. Good wool. No name. Now then, who?

steps.title: A Customer
steps.description: Good wool. No name.

objectives.text: Ask Odette Vane about the wool

lines.speaker: odette_vane
lines.text: Wool? Darling, I don't give wool away. Take this one to him. From a customer.

steps.speaker: odette_vane

steps.title: Gold Selvedge
steps.description: Only one hand hems like that.

objectives.text: Bring the wool to Barnaby

linesOnComplete.speaker: barnaby_thrale
linesOnComplete.text: From a customer. With a gold selvedge. Only one hand hems like that.

linesOnComplete.speaker: barnaby_thrale
linesOnComplete.text: Give her these. My first shears. She always wanted them. Tell her... tell her the seam held.

steps.title: The Seam Held
steps.description: Barnaby's first shears.

objectives.text: Bring the shears to Odette

linesOnComplete.speaker: odette_vane
linesOnComplete.text: His shears. The old... Barnaby. He remembered the seam.

linesOnComplete.speaker: odette_vane
linesOnComplete.text: Go away, darling. Nobody sees me like this. Thank you. Go.

afterLine.speaker: odette_vane
afterLine.text: Silverer. I'm sewing with the old man on Thursdays. Don't.

quests.title: The Watch Book
quests.summary: Maud keeps a page on every Silverer. Wren's has marks on it.

offer.speaker: maud_kettering
offer.text: Every Silverer gets a page in the Watch book, citizen. Yours has marks. Noted.

offer.speaker: maud_kettering
offer.text: Folk who saw your light go wrong. A gate can't hold if the crowd fears the one behind it.

steps.title: Good Marks
steps.description: Two faces back at the gate, and Nell to speak for me.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of 2 people at the Lantern Gate
Ask Nell Bramley to vouch for you

lines.speaker: maud_kettering
lines.text: Good marks first. Two faces back from the Tarnish, here at my gate. Then Bramley speaks for you.

steps.speaker: maud_kettering

1.speaker: nell_bramley
1.text: I'll vouch, Sergeant! Sorry, I mean, I'd like to vouch. Properly.

linesOnComplete.speaker: maud_kettering
linesOnComplete.text: Two. Noted. Now the bad marks. Corporal Greave holds the statements on Bell Lane.

steps.title: Bad Marks
steps.description: Hollis has eleven statements about me. Eleven.

objectives.text: Find Corporal Greave on Bell Lane

lines.speaker: hollis_greave
lines.text: Statements. Eleven of them. Course there are. Want them read, or want them lost?

steps.speaker: hollis_greave

choices.text: Read them to me. All of them.

response.speaker: hollis_greave
response.text: Your call. A spell through a window. A man knocked flat on Lantern Row. It goes on a while.

choices.journal: Hollis read me every one. I'd rather have the bruise than the page.

response.speaker: hollis_greave
response.text: Page fell in the canal. Shame. You owe me a flask of tea.

choices.journal: The page went in the canal. Maud will know. Maud always knows.

turnInLines.speaker: maud_kettering
turnInLines.text: Clean page. Noted. Don't make me open the book again.

accept.speaker: wren_hale
accept.text: Then tell me how to clean it.

afterLine.speaker: maud_kettering
afterLine.text: Your page is still clean, citizen. I check it every morning.

quests.availability: Best offered when the Silverer has heat (any witnessed crime); otherwise offer after main.key. On Unlocked Silverer_RecordClean: reset the Silverer's heat, let witnesses' crime memories fade, stop guards hunting.

quests.title: Shield and Lamp
quests.summary: The Third Lamp Company walks the canal rift tonight, and the Sergeant wants the Silverer in the middle of the line.

offer.speaker: aldric_mayne
offer.text: Silverer. The Third walks the canal rift tonight. The Captain won't ask you. I'm asking, charmingly.

offer.speaker: aldric_mayne
offer.text: Steel pins them, you burn them clean. Nobody we cut down comes back. That's the Captain's word, not mine.

steps.title: The Third Marches
steps.description: Mayne, Bram, Damaris with the lantern, Emeric with the horn, and Cosmo, first week.

objectives.text: Muster with the Third Company at the canal rift

lines.speaker: damaris_hobb
lines.text: Lantern's lit, chicks. Silverer in the middle, where it's bright.

steps.speaker: damaris_hobb

linesOnComplete.speaker: emeric_dunstan
linesOnComplete.text: One long blast and we march! HA! Fine night for a tale!

steps.squadNote: If squads are live, the Third Company squad (Brask's soldiers: aldric_mayne, bram_tolley, cosmo_fennick, damaris_hobb, emeric_dunstan) forms at Spot_CanalRift as the hero's ally for steps muster to pinned.

steps.title: Steel and Light
steps.description: Steel pins them. I burn them clean.

objectives.text: Hold the canal rift with the Third (60 s)
Burn the Tarnish out of 3 people

1.speaker: bram_tolley
1.text: That's one back. Behind me, you. You're safe now.

2.speaker: cosmo_fennick
2.text: Two back! Sarge, are you counting? I'm counting!

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Hold them still. I'll do the rest.

steps.speaker: wren_hale

steps.title: Pinned
steps.description: Bram had one on his shield. It wasn't fighting. It was looking at Cosmo.

objectives.text: Talk to Captain Brask

lines.speaker: bram_tolley
lines.text: Got one on the shield. It's not fighting. It's looking at Cosmo.

lines.speaker: cosmo_fennick
lines.text: Wat? Wat, it's me. Sarge, that's my brother. That's Wat!

lines.speaker: sela_brask
lines.text: Silverer. It's pinned. Burn it out or I cut it down. Choose.

choices.text: Hold him. I'll burn it out.

response.speaker: sela_brask
response.text: Then you do it. My people have done enough of this.

choices.journal: Brask wouldn't let her people do it. So it was me.

steps.title: Wat
steps.description: Wat Fennick, back with his own eyes. His mother is going to scream.

objectives.text: Burn the Tarnish out of Wat

linesOnComplete.speaker: cosmo_fennick
linesOnComplete.text: Wat. Your eyes. Your eyes are yours. Mum's going to scream.

linesOnComplete.speaker: aldric_mayne
linesOnComplete.text: Charming. Truly. I'll put that one on the roll as found.

steps.title: Wat
steps.description: He knew Cosmo. Right up to the end, he knew him.

objectives.text: Cut down the pinned tarnished

linesOnComplete.speaker: cosmo_fennick
linesOnComplete.text: No. No, no, he was looking at me. He knew me.

linesOnComplete.speaker: bram_tolley
linesOnComplete.text: I had him. I had him still. I'm sorry, Cosmo.

turnInLines.speaker: aldric_mayne
turnInLines.text: The Third thanks you. The Captain will nod at you once. Treasure it.

fail.speaker: aldric_mayne
fail.text: Fennick's down. First week. I'll write to his mother myself.

afterLine.speaker: sela_brask
afterLine.text: You fought on my line, Silverer. You can stand on it again.

offerIfWanted.speaker: aldric_mayne
offerIfWanted.text: Not while the Watch has your name in its book. Clean the page first, Silverer.

quests.availability: Refuse with offerIfWanted (SQ11_W1) while the Silverer is wanted (heat high, or a witnessed crime and no Silverer_RecordClean). Otherwise offer after main.hold_line.

quests.title: The Empty Chair
quests.summary: Cosmo's chair at the Third Company's table is empty, and the canal fog is talking in his brother's voice.

offer.speaker: damaris_hobb
offer.text: Cosmo's gone, dear. Took Wat's cap and his spear. Mercy, I know where.

offer.speaker: damaris_hobb
offer.text: The canal. He says the fog's still calling in his brother's voice. Bring him back to us.

steps.title: The Edge
steps.description: Cosmo took Wat's cap and his spear and went to the canal.

objectives.text: Find Cosmo at the canal rift
Talk to Cosmo

lines.speaker: wren_hale
lines.text: Cosmo! Step back from the edge.

steps.speaker: wren_hale

0.speaker: the_tarnish
0.text: Come and look, little brother. Your Silverer spends people like coins.

1.speaker: cosmo_fennick
1.text: It talks like him. In the fog. It says Wat's still in there and you burned nothing.

choices.text: I did it. Hate me. Not yourself.

response.speaker: cosmo_fennick
response.text: I do. I do hate you. Help me up anyway.

choices.journal: He hates me. He let me help him up anyway.

choices.text: He was gone before the shield touched him.

response.speaker: cosmo_fennick
response.text: You didn't know him. You didn't. Take me home anyway.

choices.journal: I told him Wat was already gone. Neither of us believed it.

steps.title: Marjory
steps.description: Somebody has to tell their mother. It should be me.

objectives.text: Tell Marjory Fennick on Lantern Row

lines.speaker: marjory_fennick
lines.text: You're the Silverer who was at the canal. Cosmo won't look at me. Tell me.

steps.speaker: marjory_fennick

choices.text: I cut him down. It was my call.

response.speaker: marjory_fennick
response.text: Then you'll carry him. Every day. Get away from my barrow.

choices.journal: I told her the truth. She told me to get away from her barrow.

choices.text: The Tarnish took him. We couldn't reach him.

response.speaker: marjory_fennick
response.text: Thank you for bringing my other boy home. Thank you.

choices.journal: I lied to her, and she thanked me for it. Cosmo heard every word.

turnInLines.speaker: damaris_hobb
turnInLines.text: He's at the table. He's not talking. That's a start, dear.

fail.speaker: damaris_hobb
fail.text: The fog took both Fennick boys. No lantern tonight.

afterLine.speaker: cosmo_fennick
afterLine.text: I keep Wat's cap in my helmet now. For luck. It doesn't work.

quests.availability: Only after SQ11 ended with cut_wat. A player who burned Wat clean never sees this quest.
